description: Optics are the cosmetic effects members buy with Power to show on a person's portrait (positive or negative, for a limited time), and a shield an official's supporters can buy to block negative ones. Returns the optics live on one person now (name, effect, positive or negative, the Power paid, when it ends), the positive share of all Power spent on them, and the shield's end time if one is up. Buyers are never named. Optics never change ratings or rankings.
name: get_optics
title: Get optics on a person
